items.title: Centrus Energy (LEU) Has Fresh Attention, But What Is The Market Missing?
items.summary: Oklo Inc. has locked in multi-year contracts with Centrus Energy (LEU) for high-assay low-enriched uranium, backed by Meta-funded prepayments, tying Centrus directly to Oklo’s planned 1.2 GW Ohio power campus. The Centrus Energy share price has fallen sharply in recent months, with a 30 day share price return down 13.5% and the 90 day move down 45.4%, even though the 3 year total shareholder return is still up 97.6%. items.title: Will ETF Buying Change Meta Stock Narrative
items.summary: Large ETFs including SPY, XLC and SPYM recently added to Meta Platforms positions over several days, alongside fresh fixed income offerings and expanded sustainability agreements tied to green steel, clean cement and zero emission trucking. items.title: AMD Stock Looks Poised to Revisit Its All-Time Highs
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices’ (AMD) stock looks poised to revisit its all-time highs. The market has already bought into its growth story. Now, the next opportunity may lie in how much of that growth turns into profits. After a triple-digit gain in 2026, the stock has pulled back from its October record highs, but the fundamentals help explain much of that rally. items.title: Meta tests prediction-market app for employees, WSJ reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- Meta Platforms is testing an internal prediction-market app called Takes, allowing employees to predict the outcomes of events using virtual points rather than real money, The Wall Street Journal reported Friday.
